stats.notes: From the Common Data Set 2023-2024 (fall 2023 entering class), the newest one Illinois Tech has posted (its CDS page lists nothing for 2024-25 or 2025-26): 8,912 applied, 4,939 admitted, 534 enrolled. Residency rows (in-state 3,676 / out-of-state 2,321 / international 2,726 / unknown 189) add up to the totals; admits (2,233 / 1,430 / 1,188 / 88) and enrollees (359 / 114 / 56 / 5) also add up. International (nonresident) first-years: 2,726 applied, 1,188 admitted, 56 enrolled. Early decision: 69 applications, 47 admitted. No waitlist (the CDS answers No to a waitlist policy). The average GPA of 4.20 is on a weighted scale (64% of reporting students were at 4.0 and the range goes above it); the GPA breakdown is 'all enrolled students' and sums to 99.8% as printed. Newer headline figures from IPEDS (fall 2024 entering class, College Navigator): 12,216 applicants, 55% admitted, 8% of admits enrolled, SAT submitted by 30% and ACT by 8% of enrolled first-years; IPEDS shows only percentages for admits, so they are not used here. Test scores are optional.
